t: AI Quantum Computing and Reality: Annealer Optimizer — Simple
name: AI Quantum Computing and Reality: Annealer Optimizer — Simple
title: AI Quantum Computing and Reality: Annealer Optimizer — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] An optimizer that maps combinatorial problems onto quantum annealers: it formulates the QUBO, embeds it on the hardware graph, and reads the low-energy samples. The annealer is a heuristic sampler — results are verified classically, never trusted blindly.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Landauer floor per erased bit at 300 K = 2.8710 zJ. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.

math_note: Landauer floor per erased bit at 300 K: 2.8710 zJ [verified]; Bremermann limit for 1 kg processor: 1.356e+50 ops/s [verified]
